utility_formula: utility = event_detection_rate - 0.25 * false_alerts_per_server_day + 0.10 * operational_precision + 0.10 * detected_ge_6h_fraction_of_all_events. Undefined precision/early fraction contributes zero. Event detection already penalizes misses (1 - missed/events). No TEST-informed coefficient changes.
selection_rule: Maximum validation utility; exact ties: supervised-only first, fewer false alerts, higher median lead time, candidate_id. No row metric selects the policy.
test_use: Only frozen selected hybrid policy applied to cached TEST scores. Detector overlap is inspected afterward, never for selection.
